name: Ice Release: Ten Thousand Ice Petals

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Wind Release

system.description:
You freeze Water and air in front of you while launching it forwards creating an innumerable onslaught of ice daggers that tears through everything in range. Creatures in the affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, creatures gain 2 rank of Frostbite and have their movement reduced to 0 on a failure, until the end of their next turn or half the ranks of Frostbite on a success.

If a construct, structure or object would fail their saving throw, it gains vulnerability to the next two instances of damage it takes before the beginning of your next turn as its structural integrity is affected by the extreme cold.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of the cone by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher the increase the ranks of Frostbite inflicted to +2.
